label: HypeAuditor
description: Manage influencer media plans, social listening, creator reports and email unlocks

operations.name: get_lookalikes
operations.description: Find similar creators accounts based on provided usernames or social IDs. Results are returned synchronously.

operations.name: list_listeners
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of all social listening listeners. Returns listeners with their current status, creator counts, and monitoring information.

operations.name: create_listener
operations.description: Create a new social listening listener to track mentions, hashtags, or keywords across Instagram and TikTok. The listener will continuously monitor the specified value and collect posts from creators who use it.

operations.name: get_creator_mentions
operations.description: Retrieve all posts (mentions) from a specific creator discovered through social listening. Returns posts where the creator mentioned tracked usernames, hashtags, or keywords across Instagram and TikTok. Results can be optionally filtered by a specific listener.

operations.name: list_creators
operations.description: Retrieve a paginated list of creators discovered through social listening. Returns creators who have mentioned tracked usernames, hashtags, or keywords across Instagram and TikTok. Results can be filtered by specific listener and sorted by discovery date.

operations.name: check_report_unlock
operations.description: Returns the unlock status for each requested influencer report, identified by social_type and social_id or username.

operations.name: unlock_creator_emails
operations.description: Unlocks and returns email addresses for each requested creator, identified by social_type and social_id. Spends unlock tokens when an email is unlocked.

operations.name: list_plan_accounts
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of creators’ social network accounts for a specific media plan

operations.name: add_plan_accounts
operations.description: Adds social network accounts to a specific media plan. Accepts up to 20 accounts per request

operations.name: delete_plan_accounts
operations.description: Deletes accounts from a specific media plan. Accepts up to 20 accounts per request. Accounts that are not found in the plan will be listed in the skipped array.

operations.name: list_plan_creators
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of creators for a specific media plan, including their social network accounts in a compact format. Each creator may be associated with multiple social network accounts.

operations.name: delete_plan_event
operations.description: Deletes a specific event from a media plan.

operations.name: list_plan_events
operations.description: Retrieves a paginated list of events for a specific social network account in a media plan.

operations.name: create_plan_event
operations.description: Creates a new comment event for a specific social network account in a media plan.

operations.name: list_media_plans
operations.description: Returns a paginated list of media plans

operations.name: create_media_plan
operations.description: Creates a new media plan

operations.name: get_media_plan
operations.description: Returns a single media plan with full details including configuration and creators states count

operations.name: delete_media_plan
operations.description: Deletes a media plan by its identifier

operations.name: update_media_plan
operations.description: Updates an existing media plan with the provided data. All top-level fields are optional: if not provided - field will not be updated, if null is provided - null will be written.

operations.name: get_media_plan_metrics
operations.description: Returns aggregated metrics for a media plan including overall metrics and metrics broken down by social network (Instagram, YouTube, TikTok)
